name: Uppsala Christmas Special 2025
information: **OBS:** Denna tävling pågår endast under lördagen. Under natten till söndagen kommer FMC under the Mistletoe 2025 hållas i en annan lokal i Uppsala. Mer information hittar ni under fliken "FMC under the Mistletoe 2025" Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- **N.B.:** This competition takes place only on Saturday. During the night leading into Sunday, FMC under the Mistletoe 2025 will be held at another venue in Uppsala. You can find more information under the tab "FMC under the Mistletoe 2025". We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.
